tweet.text:
My current plan for a squad based system is to use six-packs or 4-packs (or even 2-packs) as the workers.  The squad leader divides the project into sub-projects and assigns them to the packs.  It also designs the interfaces between the sub projects.  

The trick is going to be keeping those interfaces narrow and focussed so that the packs do not step on each other.  Typical project lead stuff.
